user.description: Outdoor unit, planner output optional. Afterwards add the indoor units one by one via the three-dot menu (⋮) of this entry → “Add indoor unit”.

help_temperature_unit.name: Help: Temperature unit
help_temperature_unit.description: Unit of all temperatures of the air conditioners: device temperatures and setpoints. Celsius is the default. All distances (control range, absolute limit, offsets, bands, thresholds) are given in this unit, with the same start values: 1 K becomes 1 °C or 1 °F. After changing the unit check the setpoints of the indoor units: they are not converted.

help_p_min_w.name: Help: Pmin (smallest continuous power)
help_p_min_w.description: Smallest electrical power the outdoor unit can hold continuously without cycling. While running, at least Pmin is requested; a surplus over the plan goes into the buffer. Start and stop threshold are shares of Pmin (default 80 % and 50 %). Example: Pmin 1300 W → start from 1040 W planned, stop below 650 W.

help_p_max_w.name: Help: Pmax (largest power)
help_p_max_w.description: Largest electrical power the outdoor unit draws at full load, e.g. from the data sheet or the highest measured power. It is the upper limit for the planned power: the sensor 'Max Power Source to Target' passes it to the planner as the maximum of the connection house → air conditioner.

help_outdoor_power_entity.name: Help: Outdoor unit power (sensor)
help_outdoor_power_entity.description: Sensor with the electrical power of the outdoor unit in W. Mandatory: it is the measured value for the comparison with the planned power and the basis for learning the buffer capacity. Choose the power sensor of the outdoor unit (active power, not apparent power).

help_season_entity.name: Help: Cooling switch (optional)
help_season_entity.description: Optional switch, binary sensor or input boolean that selects the operating mode of the plant: off = heating (default), on = cooling. Without an entity, or while it is unavailable, the plant heats. In cooling mode the whole control is mirrored: the buffer is a cold store, the SOC rises when the device temperatures fall (30 °C = 0 %, 15 °C = 100 %), the indoor units cool and the limits reported to the planner are mirrored around each setpoint. Changing the mode first puts all units in the neutral mode.

help_plan_entity.name: Help: Planned power (planner outputs, optional at first)
help_plan_entity.description: Leave empty when setting up for the first time: the planner output only exists after the planner has been set up with this integration's sensors. Until a sensor is selected, the installation only publishes its sensors and sends no command to the indoor units (no fallback either). Then select one or more sensors with the planned electrical power, usually the planned flow of the HAEO connection house → 'Klima' (e.g. `sensor.connection_klima_standard_source_to_target_power`, shown by HAEO 0.4.1 as 'Connection … source to target power' with braces); several sensors are summed. State = power now in W or kW, attribute `forecast` = list of `time`/`value` entries for the coming hours. Once selected: if a sensor is unavailable or the plan is older than the maximum plan age (options), the fallback applies and all indoor units heat to their standard setpoint.

data.band_down: Control range below the setpoint → Min Charge Level

data.limit_down: Absolute limit below the setpoint → Undercharge percentage
data.limit_up: Absolute limit above the setpoint → Overcharge percentage

help_entity_id.name: Help: Indoor unit
help_entity_id.description: The air conditioner of this room. Only the temperature reported by this unit counts as room temperature (as reported, in 0.5 K steps); room sensors are not used. Each indoor unit can be configured only once per installation.

help_setpoint_source.name: Help: Setpoint from
help_setpoint_source.description: Where the setpoint of this room comes from: a fixed value or an entity (a number helper, number or sensor, e.g. to change setpoints by automation or schedule). You choose one of the two and enter it in the next step. It is the reference for the deviation (priority), the SOC (worst room against its own setpoint), the absolute limit below it (heat even without plan), overheating (3 above it for 1 h → cool) and the fallback (heat to this value).

help_band_down.name: Help: Control range below the setpoint → Min Charge Level
help_band_down.description: How far below the current setpoint the temperature of this room may fall while the planner uses the buffer freely (distance in the unit of the installation, default 2). Below it the penalty zone starts. The limits follow the setpoint; for the planner the values of all rooms are averaged by area. While cooling the sides swap: the range above the setpoint is then the one the buffer is emptied into.

help_band_up.name: Help: Control range above the setpoint → Max Charge Level
help_band_up.description: How far above the current setpoint the temperature may rise while the planner charges the buffer without surcharge (default 2). Between this value and the absolute limit the planner applies the overload surcharge.

help_limit_down.name: Help: Absolute limit below the setpoint → Undercharge percentage
help_limit_down.description: Distance below the current setpoint where it is definitely over (default 3, at least the control range). Below it the room is heated even without plan. It is also the lower end of the penalty zone in the planner model.

help_limit_up.name: Help: Absolute limit above the setpoint → Overcharge percentage
help_limit_up.description: Distance above the current setpoint where it is definitely over (default 3, at least the control range). The room is not heated any further and the target sent to the unit never exceeds it (overload limit).

help_nominal_power_w.name: Help: Nominal power
help_nominal_power_w.description: Electrical power this indoor unit roughly draws at the outdoor unit while heating. It decides how many units run for the requested power: groups are added until their sum covers the request. Units with the same nominal power form a group (power class) and are switched on together when their deviation is tied, so that the load rises evenly. Enter identical values for identical units.

help_area_m2.name: Help: Area
help_area_m2.description: Weight of the room in the area-weighted limits for the planner and in the split of the buffer capacity among the rooms (diagnostic values).

help_step.name: Help: Reading step of the unit (optional)
help_step.description: Smallest change of the device temperature the unit reports (distance in the unit of the installation, default 0.5). Informational: the join margin and the activation rise should not be smaller than one step.

help_window_entity.name: Help: Window contacts
help_window_entity.description: Optional, one or more window or door contacts of the room (on = open). As soon as one of them is open, the room is taken out of the control: the unit goes to the neutral mode and counts neither for the SOC nor for the distribution.

help_setpoint_c.name: Help: Setpoint (fixed value) → Min Charge Level
help_setpoint_c.description: The fixed setpoint of this room in the unit of the installation. All limits sent to the planner follow it.

help_setpoint_entity.name: Help: Setpoint entity
help_setpoint_entity.description: Number helper, number or sensor whose value is the setpoint (in the unit of the installation, 5–30 °C or 41–86 °F). The value is read in every control cycle. Values outside the range, unavailable or non-numeric states are ignored: the last valid value counts. Before the first valid value the room is not controlled.

data.min_run_s: Minimum run time of the plant (s)
data.load_deadband_ratio: Load control dead band (share of Pmin)
data.load_settle_max_s: Longest wait for the outdoor power to settle (s)
data.settle_s: Settling time of the device temperatures (s)

help_start_ratio.name: Help: Start threshold (share of Pmin)
help_start_ratio.description: A stopped outdoor unit starts only when the plan shows at least this share of Pmin. Below, the plan is ignored and all units stay neutral. Default 0.8 (80 %).

help_stop_ratio.name: Help: Stop threshold (share of Pmin)
help_stop_ratio.description: A running outdoor unit keeps running until the plan falls below this share of Pmin; there is no pulse operation in between. Must not be larger than the start threshold. Default 0.5 (50 %).

help_min_run_s.name: Help: Minimum run time of the plant (s)
help_min_run_s.description: Once the outdoor unit has started, it keeps running for at least this long, counted from its start, even if the plan falls below the stop threshold in the meantime (at least Pmin is requested then). The timer restarts with every change from off to on, load changes do not extend it. There is no minimum pause. This prevents short cycling when the planned power jumps. Default 600 s (10 min).

help_tie_band_k.name: Help: Tie band
help_tie_band_k.description: Deviations (setpoint − device temperature) less than this apart count as equal. Equal rooms are served together, grouped by power class. Default 1 K (resolution of the units).

help_load_deadband_ratio.name: Help: Load control dead band (share of Pmin)
help_load_deadband_ratio.description: Share of Pmin around the requested power inside which the load control changes nothing. At the same time the tolerance for the outdoor power to count as settled after an adjustment. Default 0.1 (10 %).

help_load_settle_max_s.name: Help: Longest wait for the outdoor power to settle (s)
help_load_settle_max_s.description: After an adjustment the load control waits until the outdoor power has settled to learn the power per step. If it does not settle within this time, nothing is learned. The wait adapts to the plant (three times the typical settling time, at most this value). Default 600 s (10 min).

help_cutoff_k.name: Help: Cut-off distance (K)
help_cutoff_k.description: Distance of the device temperature above the setpoint (cooling: below) where an indoor unit regulates itself down. A served room stays served until its device temperature has reached this distance. Measured on two units: about 3.5. Default 3.5.

help_join_margin_k.name: Help: Join margin (K)
help_join_margin_k.description: The next room is started this far below the cut-off distance, so that it starts before the first unit cuts off and has time to draw load. 1 K covers the resolution of 0.5 K and the offset of up to 5 minutes between the readings. Default 1.

help_activation_rise_k.name: Help: Activation rise (K)
help_activation_rise_k.description: A room that was started counts as active only when its live device temperature rose by this much since its start. Until then the room it is to relieve stays served. Default 1.

help_startup_s.name: Help: Start-up phase (s)
help_startup_s.description: After the start of the plant and after every added room the measured outdoor power does not count for adjusting the number of served rooms: the power peaks a few minutes after a start and then settles. Default 600 s (10 min).

help_settle_s.name: Help: Settling time of the device temperatures (s)
help_settle_s.description: A unit that heats or cools distorts its own reading and, through the pipes, the readings of the neutral units. While any unit works and for this time after the last one stopped, a working unit holds its value and every other unit can only fall in the assessment; heated rooms fall back after the stop. Afterwards the reported values count again. 0 switches the holding off. Default 600 s (10 min).

help_neutral_mode.name: Help: Neutral mode
help_neutral_mode.description: Mode of units that are not served; it separates heating and cooling. Fan (default) keeps the device temperature meaningful, off saves the fan power (about 85 W for seven units).

help_cycle_s.name: Help: Control cycle (s)
help_cycle_s.description: Interval between control cycles. Each cycle reads plan and device temperatures, decides and sends only changed commands to the indoor units. Shorter intervals react faster but send more commands. Default 60 s.

help_soc_sigma.name: Help: SOC weighting width
help_soc_sigma.description: Width of the bell curve that weights the rooms in the comfort zone of the SOC (the control range of a room, setpoint at 0.5, measured from 0 to 1). A cold room weighs 1, a warm room weighs little. Smaller: the SOC follows the coldest room more closely, larger: it follows the mean of all rooms. Default 0.3.

help_display_offset_k.name: Help: Display offset
help_display_offset_k.description: Start value of the display offset for the SOC. The remembered temperature of a room follows a rising device temperature only when the reading exceeds the remembered value by this amount, and then keeps this distance. It hides the self-heating of the display while units work. The value is adapted in operation and shown as a diagnostic value. Default 3.5.

help_offset_threshold_pct.name: Help: Offset adaptation threshold (points)
help_offset_threshold_pct.description: If the SOC at the end of a work period differs from the SOC after all units have settled by more than this many points, the display offset is adapted. Default 10 points.

help_offset_target_pct.name: Help: Offset target deviation (points)
help_offset_target_pct.description: After an adaptation, the SOC at the end of the work period, recomputed with the new display offset, may deviate from the settled SOC by at most this many points. Default 5 points.

help_offset_cap_factor.name: Help: Offset cap factor
help_offset_cap_factor.description: The adapted display offset never exceeds this factor times the largest measured deviation of a device temperature above its setpoint. Default 1.25.

help_soc_smoothing_s.name: Help: SOC smoothing (s)
help_soc_smoothing_s.description: Time window for smoothing the SOC (median of the values within the window). Default 900 s (15 min).

help_outlier_k.name: Help: Outlier limit per cycle
help_outlier_k.description: If a device temperature jumps by more than this within one cycle, the value is discarded. If the next cycle confirms the new value, it is accepted. Default 2 K.

help_overheat_k.name: Help: Overheating above setpoint
help_overheat_k.description: A room at least this much above its setpoint counts as overheated. Default 3 K.

help_overheat_s.name: Help: Overheating duration (s)
help_overheat_s.description: How long a room must be overheated before it is cooled. Cooling only happens while no unit heats. Default 3600 s (1 h).

help_plan_max_age_s.name: Help: Maximum plan age (s)
help_plan_max_age_s.description: If the plan has not been updated for longer than this, it counts as outdated and the fallback applies (all units heat to their standard setpoint). Default 1800 s.

help_fallback_delay_s.name: Help: Wait before fallback (s)
help_fallback_delay_s.description: If the plan is missing or outdated (planner failed, Home Assistant just restarted), the units stay as they are for this long; the protection rules (absolute limit, window contacts, overheating) still apply. If the plan returns in time, nothing changes. The building is slow, so waiting is harmless. Default 600 s (10 min).

help_fallback_step_s.name: Help: Fallback step interval (s)
help_fallback_step_s.description: After the wait, the fallback switches the units to heating with their standard setpoints step by step: one group of equal nominal power per step, largest deviation first. Units that already run stay on. Default 120 s.

data.discharge_limit_w: Buffer discharge limit → Max discharge power (W)
data.night_setback_k: Night setback of Min Charge Level and Undercharge percentage
data.undercharge_cost: Penalty between the control range and the absolute limit → Undercharge cost (per kWh)
data.late_charge_surcharge: Late charge surcharge → Charge cost (per kWh)

help_efficiency_pct.name: Help: Buffer efficiency → Charge efficiency (%)
help_efficiency_pct.description: Efficiency of the climate buffer in the planner model (losses while storing heat). Default 92 %.

help_discharge_limit_w.name: Help: Buffer discharge limit → Max discharge power (W)
help_discharge_limit_w.description: Highest discharge power of the buffer in the planner model, i.e. how fast the house loses heat. Default 3500 W.

help_night_start_h.name: Help: Night setback start (hour)
help_night_start_h.description: Full hour (local time) at which the night setback starts. Only the lower bounds for the planner are lowered. Default 21.

help_night_end_h.name: Help: Night setback end (hour)
help_night_end_h.description: Full hour (local time) at which the night setback ends. Default 6.

help_night_setback_k.name: Help: Night setback of Min Charge Level and Undercharge percentage
help_night_setback_k.description: Lower bounds of the control range and the absolute limit for the planner are lowered by this much at night. The protection at the absolute limit in the room stays unchanged. Default 1 K (assumption, not fixed in the functional spec).

help_undercharge_cost.name: Help: Penalty between the control range and the absolute limit → Undercharge cost (per kWh)
help_undercharge_cost.description: Penalty per kWh when the planner discharges the buffer between the control range and the absolute limit. Default 0.003 (slightly below that of the car charging).

help_overcharge_cost.name: Help: Overload surcharge → Overcharge cost (per kWh)
help_overcharge_cost.description: Surcharge per kWh for charging between the upper bound without surcharge and the overload limit. Default 0.003 (assumption, not fixed in the functional spec).

help_late_charge_surcharge.name: Help: Late charge surcharge → Charge cost (per kWh)
help_late_charge_surcharge.description: Small amount per kWh that falls linearly to 0 over the forecast horizon. It only decides between equally priced time windows: then the planner charges later (less storage loss). Default 0.001.

help_planner_horizon_h.name: Help: Planner forecast horizon (h)
help_planner_horizon_h.description: Number of hours in the forecasts of the planner values. Should be at least the planner's horizon. Default 24.

outdoor_power_missing.title: Outdoor unit power sensor missing
outdoor_power_missing.description: {name} needs the power sensor of the outdoor unit. Open the entry, three-dot menu → Reconfigure, and select it.

reset_learned_capacity.name: Reset learned capacity
reset_learned_capacity.description: Sets the learned buffer capacity (heating and cooling) back to the start value. Only meaningful after fundamental changes to the plant; not needed in daily use.

config_entry_id.name: Installation
config_entry_id.description: Only this installation. Empty = all installations.

config_entry_id.description: Only this installation. Empty = all installations.

set_display_offset.name: Set display offset
set_display_offset.description: Sets the display offset of the SOC by hand. It is adapted again after the next work period if the SOC deviates too much.

config_entry_id.description: Only this installation. Empty = all installations.

set_largest_deviation.name: Set largest measured deviation
set_largest_deviation.description: Sets the largest measured deviation of a device temperature above its setpoint by hand. Empty = not measured yet; the display offset is then not adapted until a deviation is measured.
